messages:
Alex H: Quick heads-up — legal asked for the EULA stub and trial length for the AWS listing. We need to confirm 30-day trial + meter to SKU mapping. Anyone on this?
Maria P: I'm on it. Do we want a free-tier or just trial credits? Marketplace usually prefers a 0-cost free tier for small usage.
Sam T: For our pricing model, trial credits work better to prevent unlimited sandboxing. Also need to ensure metering maps to 'inference-hour' SKU not token-count.
Alex H: Good call. @Jen K can you confirm with Product whether we can expose 'trial credits' in the publisher portal preview?
Jen K: Yep — publisher portal can show a "Trial credits" badge. Need the manifest field names. I can produce a sample manifest: 
```
sku: redwood-inference-basic
trial_credits: 1000
metering_unit: inference-hour
```
Maria P: Legal wants the EULA paragraph that mentions data residency for Marketplace trials — we should state no customer data leaves their region during trial.
Sam T: Also note: AWS requires a lead-gen landing page link and a support contact. We have support@redwood.com but need a dedicated PM contact.
Alex H: I'll add a short landing page draft. @marketplace-bot can you add a staging subscription for the AWS sandbox account org-redwood-test?
marketplace-bot: Created staging subscription aws-sandbox-2026 for org-redwood-test — credentials posted to #env-secrets (rotating token in 1h). :lock:
Jen K: Great. Next steps: I'll hand off manifest + publisher preview by EOD, Maria will feed Legal the EULA draft, Sam will map metering -> SKU. Sync tomorrow 10am to sign-off.
Alex H: Thanks team :thumbsup: If anyone runs into permission issues with the staging account ping me.
